result.topic_en: Counting calculations for theta-function characteristics (symbols like χ with upper and lower indices) in terms of m, μ, p and r, giving the number of free parameters and of constants, with a table of 0/1 characteristic columns.
result.transcription:
36.
[-$\chi\begin{pmatrix} m & n \\ s & z\end{pmatrix}$-] $p = (m-1)(n-1) - r$
$p = 2\mu - 2$ | $r = (\mu-1)(\mu-3)$
$p = 2\mu - 3$ | $r = (\mu-2)^2$
[-$\mathfrak{C}\begin{pmatrix} m-2 & n-2 \\ s & z\end{pmatrix}$-]
$\mathfrak{C}\,s$
$\chi\begin{pmatrix} \mu & \mu \\ s, & z\end{pmatrix}$ $p + r = (\mu-1)(\mu-1) - p$
$\mathfrak{C}\begin{pmatrix} \mu-2 & \mu-2 \\ s & z\end{pmatrix}$ [-$(\mu-1)(\mu-1)$-] $m\mu - \mu(\mu-2) - 1$
$\chi\begin{pmatrix} \mu-1 & \mu-1 \\ s & z\end{pmatrix}$ [-$p^2 - \ldots$-] $2m\mu - 2(\mu-1)^2 + 2p$
[-$2p - 1 + p$-] $(m-\mu+2)(2\mu-3) \quad + 2(p-1)$
$(m-\mu+2)(2\mu-3) + p - 1$
$\chi\begin{pmatrix} m+\mu & m+\mu \\ s & z\end{pmatrix} + p + [-m-] {+(m+1)^2+} - (\mu-1)^2 - (m-\mu+1)^2 \ldots = [-p + 2(\mu-1)(m-\mu+1)-]$
[-$(m-\mu+1)(m+\mu-1-m+\mu-1)$-]
$(m-\mu+2)(m+\mu) - (m-\mu+2)(m-\mu+3) + p - 1$
$\chi\begin{pmatrix} \mu & \mu \\ s, & z\end{pmatrix}$
